resource_profile.work: No global vertex vector. Let L be sum actual bounded canonical metadata byte lengths for Body,Request,Envelope,index,checker descriptor, SOURCE,INSTALL,RUNTIME,bundle snapshot and five archive metadata entries plus each parsed DeclarationSource once. Each digest/containment occurrence consumes at least one distinct metadata byte; parse/field visits are bounded by each qualified raw parser. Stream every incidence once. Each target lookup scans at most96 addressable records or15 ordinary complete source keys; checker16/installer128/runtime32 fixed inventories remain separate. A conservative per-invocation candidate work allowance is L*(96+16+16+128+32+1)+15*15*15, charged for every incidence, candidate comparison, scan advance and sourceDAG matrix round. This is an explicit finite engineering bound, not a formal whole-runtime allocation proof. Path enumeration retains independently frozen work/path/output limits. Any accounting inconsistency/refusal cannot produce success. No arbitrary global guessed32-node bound.
